code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    ones = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 1]
    twos = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 2]
    (r, c), (tr, tc) = ones[0], twos[0]
    dr = 1 if tr > r else -1
    dc = 1 if tc > c else -1
    rem_r, rem_c = abs(tr-r), abs(tc-c)
    if rem_r <= rem_c:
        while abs(tr-r) > 1:
            r += dr; c += dc
            out[r][c] = 3
        while abs(tc-c) > 1:
            c += dc
            out[r][c] = 3
    else:
        while abs(tc-c) > 1:
            r += dr; c += dc
            out[r][c] = 3
        while abs(tr-r) > 1:
            r += dr
            out[r][c] = 3
    return out
'''
